title: World generator and deeper fog
kicker: World and empire · procedural maps and scouting craft
hook: **Vision:** procedural world generation and richer fog / scouting craft. Not finished / not playable yet.

blindSpots.meaning: Locked design. Procedural generator and deeper fog craft are not the live map pipeline you rely on today.
Procedural maps for the rift — not a lawn level editor and not a random lawn match picker.
Richer scouting and uncertainty tools beyond basic hold-clear / else-fog.
Basic fog of war already plays — this page is the deeper generator/craft Vision on top.

alsoTrue: Basic [fog of war](fog-of-war) ships now. This page is not a claim that fog is missing entirely.
Hangs with three-layer presentation and world events as wider Vision.

sections.title: Not finished / not playable yet
paras: Do not expect a new procedural world each run as a finished feature.
Play the shipped map and fog; treat generator depth as future craft.

sections.title: What it is (design)
paras: Procedural maps so the rift can be a place that is made, not only hand-authored once.
Deeper fog craft so scouting stays interesting as empires grow.

groups.title: On new worlds and scouting
groups.intro: When it ships, generation and craft hang on adventure and prestige of place.
steps: Start or continue a world as you do now.
Expect richer map birth and scouting tools only when this Vision lands.
Until then, use basic fog and End Turn without waiting on a generator panel.
groups.note: Not in the current loop yet.

doTitle: What you do with this page
doSteps: Use the shipped world map and fog today.
Do not hunt for a generator settings screen — it is Vision.
When a new world starts later, remember generation is design intent, not a promise of today’s builds.
doNote: Stop when generator ≠ “fog is broken.” Live fog: [fog of war](fog-of-war).

mixUps.q: Why is every map the same?
mixUps.a: Deeper procedural generation is Vision. Today’s graph is still the playable adventure.
No. Basic fog ships. This page is deeper craft and generation.
No. It is about the rift world map.

mixUps.q: Is this required to End Turn?
mixUps.a: No. Virtual turns already work on the shipped map.
